spec.name: Halloween Spectral Fishing Rod
spec.description: An original Orange SMP Halloween fishing rod with a stepped dark-oak shaft, iron reel, teal spectral line and tiny ghost float. Entirely axis-aligned geometry preserves a clear diagonal silhouette and transparent negative space. Ghost eyes and mouth are painted directly onto its atlas.

prompt: Handheld fishing rod of dark wood with teal spectral line and a tiny ghost-shaped float. Clear diagonal thin rod silhouette, no scene. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
